reviews.title: Subscription issues
reviews.text: Long story short, I wanted to test out this app during the trial period. I noticed on the subscription page the opportunity to switch to a cheaper subscription, but there was no prompt warning me the charge would be instantaneous nor that I would no longer be in the “trial” period and go straight to paid service. That was extremely disappointing. The app itself? It has great potential, but I’d argue it’s overpriced. I would like a feature to block app access, and if there is one, I’d like it to be more obvious because I can’t find it. The gameplay aspect is a nice touch but needs further development; it’s rather clunky. Im not incentivized to plant trees or free people using my focus points, so the dopamine reward is quite blunted. I almost wonder if less is more. Again, it has a lot of potential but I feel I very much overpaid.

reviews.title: Very well thought through!
reviews.text: Great app!! I tried many different habit tracking options, but this one does the things the way I like them! Habit and goal tracking is done just the way I like it! In particular, displaying of the habit progress and how it ties to a goal, and that you can see how much time you spent on that goal. Makes me feel accomplished to look back and say: hey, I put in good amount of effort into this goal this week, I am making progress!

reviews.title: Great game just needs some improvements
reviews.text:
I love this game!!! It’s super motivating, especially after studying and getting to see my character level up. Getting the little chest and rewards, makes finishing task feel way more satisfying, and it actually makes me want to keep going. 

There are just a few things that feel a little off to me. The writing animation feels pretty fast, and sometimes it looks like my character is running in mid air instead of just actually making contact with the ground. The jumping also feels a little too high. I think, slowing the movement down a bit and making the animation smoother, and making the character feel more grounded will make a big difference. Adding shadows could help with that too. 
I also think some of the characters are a little too detailed compared to the style of the rest of the game. 
By making the avatars and plants simplistic to the rest of the world, the same 8 or 16 bit size of the world. A little more or consistency in the character designs would make everything fit together better. 

Overall, I really loved the game, especially the leveling system. It makes studying feel so much more rewarding!

reviews.title: Manipulative

That’s tricking people and deciding it’s worth the money to spend on this app. There are other ways to communicate to someone that they could be spending their time and more valuable ways than on the phone without that level of shame, and folding to corporate greed “self-help “propaganda

reviews.title: Probably great for some people.
reviews.text:
First of all, contrary to many other reviewers, I think that the annual subscription fee is fair to keep the game advertisement free considering the fact that a solo dev is providing ongoing updates. ~$6USD/month is totally reasonable. That said, the other options get a bit wacky in my opinion. $7 per week shouldn’t be an option. Someone who accidentally leaves a subscription like that running might unwittingly spend over $360 annually, and I think the monthly fee is a bit high, nearing World of Warcraft’s monthly subscription fee. 

That said, I ran into some performance issues, and I didn’t always feel like I was being rewarded for completing tasks, which led to a pattern of leaving the timer to run even after I had completed the task at hand. 

Once you cross that threshold into running the timer despite inactivity, you’re defeating the purpose of the app altogether, and while I accept full responsibility for my own actions, it became more about trying to manipulate the game into giving me what I wanted than improving my focus.

I used this app on and off for a year, and it was a fun and engaging way to build better habits. The combat in sessions and updated trials in adventure mode were engaging without being inaccessible, and I don’t remotely regret using the app. I also think the newest update sounds exciting, and I might be willing to return at a later date, but as my annual subscription fee is coming up again, I find that the cost, performance issues, and occasional bugs make it difficult for me to justify continuing. 

I think this app has a lot of potential, and I think I might recommend it to a certain kind of person, but for general people, I would give it 3/5 stars.

reviews.title: Where did all my points go?
reviews.text:
When I opened Focus Hero this morning, it started up and acted like it was my very first time. I don’t know what happened, but I’m pretty upset because I assume this means all the points I’ve been earning are gone. How do I fix this!? This would have been a five star review, but after this, I don’t know. 
UPDATE: I went to the App Store and found a message inviting anyone to email the creator of this app with issues so I did.  I received a very quick reply!  Turns out my font setting were too big which affected how much of the app screen I could see.  They advised me on how to fix this and now the app is working again.  They said they’re submitting another update that should be available soon.  I’m really pleased with their help and quick reply!  They seem very dedicated to having a high quality app 😊

reviews.title: One of the scummiest app intros ever
reviews.text:
Dear god, I have never had an app that bugged me so much to subscribe as soon as I start it. Not only that, the "no thanks, I don't want to subscribe" buttons take a minute to fade in and are then incredibly faint, like those bad mobile game ads.  There's even one screen where they make the X button blend in with the dog behind it so it's even harder to see!

Really scummy, and then after saying no to a trial 5 times, it bothers you with incredibly long animations and five more screens just to say "Hey, I can help get your life together." Other apps do this but don't have nearly as many screens or long animations for it.

And when you finally get past those obnoxious screens, you realize task customization is really limited, like not being able to control how often a task repeats.

I can only assume the target audience for this focus app is boomers and children.

reviews.title: Immediately charged despite “free trial.” Refund denied. Possible scam.
reviews.text:
I want to like this app, but the financial aspect is far too scammy.

Within three hours of installing this app, I was charged the full $59.99 subscription price despite the App Store listing a seven‑day free trial with a reminder before the trial ends.

I gave the app a second chance to see if I wanted to continue using it. On day five (yesterday), I decided it wasn’t a good fit for me and requested a refund from Apple, since I was well within the trial period. Apple denied the request with the message “This purchase is not eligible for a review,” which I’m currently appealing.

Based on Reddit threads and App Store reviews, this exact issue has been reported by users for over a year. I’m now on day six of the trial and still have not received a refund. If the issue isn’t resolved, I will have no choice but to report the app for potential ongoing fraud, since users have reported losing hundreds of dollars to this unresolved issue.

Final review pending resolution of this ongoing issue.

reviews.title: Lots of potential
reviews.text:
The structure is here for a really great app, but there are some issues. The concept overall is great, but the implementation is often buggy and confusing. Adventure mode is an interesting idea, but the combat mechanics don’t always function right.

Equipping items has its own bugs. Sometimes selecting an item removes other items, or items change appearance.

Sounds on the timer also stop working often.

Despite the bugs, the basic mechanic of setting a timer and getting rewards (skill gain, gold, items) and unlocking new areas did keep me coming back during the free trial.

I appreciate the effort and the work done here by a solo dev, but I think, ironically, this app could use a more focused approach. It seems like it is trying to do too much without the core functionality being ironed out.

reviews.title: I like it… but it’s rough
reviews.text:
Reward me for focus? Say no more. This is a brilliant way to gamify your productivity and I was so excited to put this to work.
But… there’s 2 issues with this that make me uninterested in going premium or even keeping it on my phone.

1) you’re able to set up different goals you’re working towards. A few of mine are “chores”, “exercise”, “self care”. When you train, you pick your goal and the skill you’re training with it. I like this idea because it tracks the time set towards each goal. Ideally, you can review these numbers every few days or weekly and determine where you might want to spend some more time.
2 star rating because when I’m doing my focus, the app often switches the goal I’ve actually selected to the first one on the list. My goal numbers are wildly inaccurate as a result with over 19 hours in one goal area and less than 4 hours in every other one.
If I was only using the app for focus and not for balance, this wouldn’t be an issue. But not being able to consistently track which goal I’m committing to is a huge fail in my book and it makes your time data useless

2) I was able to adventure when I first downloaded the app. And that’s it. If you don’t get premium, this app is nothing but a timer. I don’t know why they let me explore the adventure tab and bird/pet shops for about 30 hours before putting them behind a permanent paywall… but I’ve never seen those screens since.
I could be enticed to check them out… but the existing glitchiness of the app really turns me off from rewarding them with my money.

To get 5 stars on my review:
- fix the “set goal” in the focus tab to not reset. OR let me edit the times I’ve spent on tasks later so they properly reflect where my time was spent 
- be clear about paywalls or don’t tease us. I spent a few minutes in adventure, realized I needed my stats up, and then never got to see the adventure screen again.

I love the idea for this app but it’s kind of busted right now imo

I like having the flexibility to do either. Game is gorgeous too, the pixel art is really pretty. Plus the equipment-set completion and pet collecting mechanics are like catnip for me. Really nice app, impressive that it’s built by one person
